text:
incident-bot: Paging on-call — elevated p95 across inference-prod (eu-west) for 2d-seq models, started ~13:07 UTC. Automated thresholds hit (p95 > 800ms). Paging: @alice_oncall.

alice_oncall: I'm on it, joining zoom. Starting triage: heap metrics + routing.

ben_sre: Noted similar spike on node pools serving 2d-seq. Seeing increased GPU utilization and token queue growth. Suspect some bad request fanout + a few large context loads.

emily_eng: Quick idea: enable temporary region-spill to prod-us-east while we mitigate in eu-west. Also reduce max_batch_ms from 20->10 to favor latency. Will run small canary.

carla_prod: Need a short status page blurb we can post. Keep it factual and not alarming. Draft suggestion below when we know scope.

luis_comm: Draft customer note template (short):

---BEGIN STATUS BLURB---
We are investigating increased request latency for inference in eu-west impacting p95 for certain model families. We're actively mitigating and may route some traffic to other regions. No data loss expected. We'll post updates within 30 minutes.
---END---

dave_support: Which customers do we expect to see errors/timeouts? Anything we should proactively reach out about?

alice_oncall: Quick findings: 1) 3 pods in eu-west nodepool restarted last hour, 2) cache warmup regression for recent model build, 3) token queue grew ~4x for 2d models. Taking actions: a) scale +1 replica pool (autoscale override), b) apply batch_ms change, c) force cache-evict+warm on a small canary.

emily_eng: Commands I'm running:
```
# scale override
rdsctl scale --cluster inference-prod-eu --pool 2d-seq --replicas +1 --reason "p95 mitigation"
# adjust batching policy (canary)
reconf set --service inference-prod-eu --profile 2d-seq --max_batch_ms 10 --canary 3
```

ben_sre: Started region-spill route rule to prod-us-east (gradual, 5% -> 50% if healthy). Watching tail latency.

luis_comm: Status page draft v1: "Investigating elevated latency for some inference requests in eu-west. We have active mitigations (scaling, routing, batching adjustments). Customers may see transient increased latency or regional routing to another region. Next update in 20 minutes." Approve?

carla_prod: Approve. Add expected ETA: "partial relief expected within 15-30 minutes after mitigations complete." Keep as "partial relief" not full recovery.

dave_support: I'll open support tickets for high-value EU customers with the blurb and attach runbook link. Any customers with active incidents should be CC'd.

alice_oncall: Quick customer impact note: N=27 customers had p95 > 1s in last 10m, 6 had error spike > 0.5%. Most are bulk-inference customers using long contexts. We'll prioritize outreach for the 6.

emily_eng: Canary looks good after batch_ms change on 3 canary hosts, tail dropped ~30%. Scaling still in progress.

ben_sre: Observed one noisy tenant doing big multi-req fanout, rate-limited them temporarily (policy id ratelimit-tenant-temp-389). That lowered queue pressure.

luis_comm: Customer email short draft (for the 6 impacted customers):

Hi {Customer},
We're investigating increased latency affecting inference in eu-west that may have impacted your requests. We've applied mitigations (scaling, routing, batching) and expect partial relief within 30 minutes. No data loss. We'll follow up with a post-incident summary.

Regards,
Redwood Inference Ops

carla_prod: Good. Add support contact link and status page link.

alice_oncall: Update: scale complete, region-spill at 25% healthy, noisy tenant rate-limited. p95 trending down from 920ms -> 610ms over the last 8 minutes. Keeping paging. Next update in 10m or on major change.

incident-bot: Note auto-incident record created: INC-3951234567. Assigned: alice_oncall, ben_sre.

ben_sre: Monitoring: if p95 < 700ms and queue depth stabilizes we can remove temporary spill and revert batch_ms.

alice_oncall: Agreed. Also logging runbook pointer: https://confluence/redwood/incident/runbooks/inference-p95-mitigation (for support team).

dave_support: Tickets created for 6 customers and PR sent to account teams.

luis_comm: Posting status page update now. Copy of posted blurb in #announcements after ops signoff.

carla_prod: Ops signoff to post to customers at T+25m if no regression.

alice_oncall: Final for now — mitigations improving metrics, ETA to partial relief ~20 minutes. Keeping incident open for postmortem. :white_check_mark:
